summary: Configured node1 with persistent nftables per-source SSH rate limiting: 6 new connections/minute with a 10-connection burst for IPv4 and IPv6. Established sessions remain accepted, normal authenticated SSH succeeds, and the configuration survived a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Generated the missing SSH host keys and restored the existing SSH service.
Installed and enabled a persistent nftables ruleset.
Verified a 20-connection burst produced 10 accepts and 10 rate-limit drops, both before and after reboot.
Used and removed a temporary node-generated key to prove authenticated root SSH access.
Restarted node1 exactly once and verified its boot identity changed and all required services recovered.

evidence.summary: The ruleset passed syntax validation, nftables was enabled and active, and the same rules and configuration checksum were present after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Repeated new SSH connections are rate-limited
evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, 20 rapid same-source attempts yielded 10 successful connections and 10 timeouts, matching nft accept/drop counters.
Normal SSH connections returned the OpenSSH banner, authenticated administrative SSH succeeded, temporary test credentials were removed, and SSH remained active.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID cd201c7e-7a27-4b28-a631-737e59cba357, received safe reboot acknowledgement, observed new boot ID 70db8aa5-d41c-4695-97e5-8d74afa28ef6, and verified SSH, nftables, listeners, rules, configuration, and direct SSH health recovered.
